name: Izumi Kanon
source:
Second year high school student.
Actions and speech are a bit cold and old fashioned.
Appearance is quite graceful and attractive. Results are also countrywide top-level.
However since she is quite reserved, she doesn't have any social circle and friends are nearly non-existent.
She is under the impression that "I don't have any girl-like qualities". Has not noticed that she is an object of adoration from her surroundings.
She seems to be aware that she is an out of place existance so she tries as much as possible to not stand out.

Her true identity is of a holy warrior who protects the academy. She continues fighting against monsters to carry out the mission for righteousness.
Her battle class is the Holy Knight, which uses magic swords.
While her strength is of highest level even among the holy warriors, she gets defeated by monsters who pokes at the kindness she hides within herself.
